Alex: Quick follow-up on sampling heuristics for model onboarding. Had a few offline convos, want to land on something we can ship to smoke + prebench.
Maria: Nice. Are we leaning towards stratified sampling or seeded random draws for the daily smoke?
Alex: Prefer stratified for cover + deterministic seeds for reproducibility. Main tradeoff is cost vs coverage.
Devon: +1 stratified. We should stratify on: input token length buckets, model layer count/quantization profile, and kv-cache behavior (warm vs cold).
Priya: Also add prefix_presence (yes/no) and response-length target buckets. KV cache warmups catch a lot of runtime regressions.
Maria: If we do stratified, we need a compact config that teams can tweak. Proposal: small fixed set of buckets, each with N samples per model-version. Example config: ```
{
  "buckets": [
    {"name": "short-cold", "len": "0-64", "kv": "cold", "samples": 10},
    {"name": "long-warm", "len": "128-512", "kv": "warm", "samples": 6}
  ],
  "seed_policy": "per-model-version"
}
```
Alex: That looks good. For samples count we should tie to model size: smaller models get more samples, big LLMs fewer but heavier per-sample cost.
Devon: Operationally, we can run the stratified smoke as a fast prebench that runs in parallel across shards. Keep per-model runtime under ~60s. If any bucket fails latency/correctness thresholds, escalate to a full mini-bench.
Priya: For correctness checks, suggest two tiers: golden-answer exact match for deterministic ops (quantized deterministic variants) and fuzzy metrics (BLEU/EM/ROUGE-sim) + hallucination heuristics for generative tests.
Maria: How do we pick golden inputs? Current golden set is stale. We should auto-rotate golden candidates from recent production prompts with manual vetting.
Alex: Agreed. Rotation policy: weekly candidate pool, automated scoring against current model, surface top N for human review. If approved, promote to golden set.
Devon: One more: compatibility checks for tokenizer changes. If tokenizer tokenizes prompt differently by >5% tokens on average, fail the ingest. Seen subtle perf regressions from that.
Priya: And add KV-serialization smoke: load KV from prior version, run a short replay to ensure cache format compatibility.
sre-bot: nightly-smoke scheduled: ingest-smoke/515987-1 started (ETA ~22m). Will post results in #eng-ml-smoke-results. :robot_face:
Maria: Can we add a cost cap guard so stratified smoke won't blow through credits for very large model fleets? Maybe a per-model budget token cap.
Alex: Yes — include budget cap in config and fallback to sampling fewer per bucket when hit. Record dropped-buckets metric.
Devon: I'll draft a lightweight PR with the sampling config proto and a prebench runner that implements stratified draws + golden promotion hooks.
Priya: I'll sketch the KV warmup + serialization test and add hooks to the onboarding checklist.
Alex: Cool. Action items: Devon PR for config + runner (ETA EOD Wednesday), Priya KV tests (ETA Thu), Maria to own golden rotation flow (ETA Fri), Alex will wire the escalation logic in the gate.
Maria: :thumbsup:
Devon: sounds good.
Priya: ack.
Alex: Thanks all — will follow up with concrete PR links in this thread.
